 Shehbaz Sharif Trolled | Pakistan Hong Kong Sixes Win Controversy; India
 'Fact check bhi nahi kiya', Aakash Chopra slams Shehbaz Sharif: Pak PM trolled for celebrating Hong Kong Sixes win vs India, gets community note
 12 hours ago 
 Copy link 
 Pakistan cricket is usually at the receiving end of criticism in the sports world due to various controversies like the Asia Cup trophy and the betting accusations during the England tour. However, now Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is facing flak after congratulating the national team on its 4-wicket victory over India in Hong Kong International Sixes 2026 on Friday.
 Sharif's celebratory post on X did not go down well with several fans, who questioned why the Pakistan government was making such a big deal out of a win in a six-a-side tournament, which is considered more of an entertainment spectacle than a traditional cricket competition.
 The trolling also included a response from former cricketer turned commentator Aakash Chopra, who pointed out the cluelessness of the Pakistan PM in his congratulatory post for his nation's cricket team. But first, check out Shehbaz Sharif's post on X…
 Sharif had taken to X to praise the team's performance and acknowledge the efforts of the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB).
 ‘Fact check bhi nahin kiya’: Aakash Chopra's retaliatory fire at Pakistan PM 
 Former cricketer turned commentator Aakash Chopra pointed out the major mistake in Pakistan PM's X tweet, in which the latter mentioned the India-Pakistan Hong Kong Sixes game as the opening match of the tournament. However, in reality, the matchup was the seventh fixture of the tournament.
 Chopra posted on X:
 ‘Humne Bharat Ko Hara Diya’ bolne ki itni jaldi hai ki fact-check bhi nahin kiya. UAE se haare in the opening game. And also, you can gauge the quality of cricket Pakistan is playing that country's PM is tweeting about Hong Kong Sixes. I mean. Really!!! 
 Memes on India's loss vs Pakistan in Hong Kong Sixes 
 It was not just cricket pundits who slammed the Pakistan PM for his oblivious remark. Sharif's celebratory post on X did not go down well with several fans, who questioned why the Pakistan government was making such a big deal out of a win in a six-a-side tournament. Moreover, the competition is considered more of an entertainment spectacle than a traditional cricket competition.
 The reaction was quite raw given Pakistan's recent struggles against India in international cricket. Fans mocked the Prime Minister for celebrating a victory in the shortened format while pointing to the larger rivalry between the two countries. Some also raised eyebrows about whether a result in an exhibition-style tournament needed a congratulatory message from the country's top political leader.
 Pakistan Cricket posts celebratory video on X after India win 
 The official account of the Pakistan Cricket Board also posted a video on the X(formerly Twitter) of fan interaction with the Pakistan team after they registered a victory against India.
 Pakistan have been knocked out of Hong Kong Sixes 2026 
 It's worth noting that defending champions Pakistan have been knocked out of the Hong Kong Sixes Cup 2026.
 Despite registering a dominant victory over arch-rivals India, a narrow defeat to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in their opening match saw Pakistan finish second in Group C, ending the team's hopes of defending the title under the tournament's format. The tournament exit ended Pakistan's bid for a seventh title in the main Cup competition.
